mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 0.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and declines in the unemployment rate signal an overheating economy triggering aggressive Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve accelerates rate hikes to combat inflation, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 6.0%, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the prior 6 months indicates tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has declined over the prior 6 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals an extremely tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has been below 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and increases in industrial production signal a shift from residential construction to manufacturing growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices balanced economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines and INDPRO rises over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market contraction regimes (HOUST < 1100.0 thousand units), weakness in residential construction signals broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 1100.0, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
